title: Standing private Kaggle backups: trainer registry-store + ml/served (Kaggle Model), trade_journal.db + trainer_store.db snapshots and the cold data lake (private datasets), scheduled, checksum-verified, freshness stamp
note: OPERATOR DECISION (chat, ~17:02Z 2026-11-05, verbatim): "Ok, let's also keep backups on kaggle (on private)". Via manager Manager Session 2026-11-05b. SPEC: (a) this row; (b) a scheduled GitHub Actions backup to PRIVATE Kaggle only: trainer model registry-store + ml/served as versions of a private Kaggle Model; snapshots of trade_journal.db and trainer_store.db (sqlite backup API, consistent copy) and the cold data lake as private datasets; NEVER credentials (no env files, account keys, secrets); verify each backup by checksum; record a freshness stamp the health review can read; on failure retry and raise ONE red flag, never halt. (c) Retention: keep last N versions; delete NOTHING on Kaggle or anywhere without asking the operator first; propose N. Nothing reads from Kaggle on the trade path; live trader and trainer keep local copies as the source of truth. Ship as a PR; report the green SHA plus the first verified backup run; BEFORE the first upload tell the manager the first full size vs the operator quota (datasets 2.89 GB of 214.75 GB, models 0 of 214.75 GB). SEQUENCE: after the 10 GB dataset trial and the Kaggle Models pilot both pass. NOTE: docs/research/ml-data-classification-2026-10-13.md kept OUR data (trades, fills, signals, PnL) out of the Kaggle export; this operator decision supersedes it for PRIVATE backups. 2026-11-05 ~21:22Z OPERATOR DECISION (popup, verbatim): "Trainer copy, weekly x8 (Rec.)" -> weekly snapshot of the TRAINER's nightly replica data/trade_journal.db (2.47 GB; NOT the stale 8.5 MB resolver file, NOT the live VM) with the sqlite backup API, gzip, copy to private Kaggle with SHA-256 + freshness stamp; keep the last 8; deletion beyond 8 asks the operator first (nothing auto-deleted). Built as mode db of kaggle-backups.yml (cron Sunday 09:41Z): one private dataset per snapshot (metis-trade-journal-YYYYMMDD) so no weekly re-upload of old snapshots; stamp lists snapshots + beyond_retention. Models mode (registry-store + ml/served) verified 2026-11-05 run 42106677313 and merged in #23333. trainer_store.db does not exist at its resolver path on the trainer (rebuilt lazily on read, so low backup value): not backed up. 2026-11-06 08:50Z lane HF-LAKE-SQUASH. FIRST SCHEDULED RUN HAS NOT HAPPENED: at 06:26Z and again at 08:33Z kaggle-backups.yml has ZERO event=schedule workflow runs (actions list filtered by event schedule: total_count 0) although the models cron '23 4 * * *' was due at 04:23Z (>4 h). The workflow is active, the cron entries are on main (commits 59e8ced63 2026-11-05 21:19Z and 1fe25c4f6 22:14Z), and comms/backups/kaggle_latest.json on main is still the initial empty stamp (generated 2026-11-05T18:10Z, 'NO backup has run yet'). The same file's issues and pull_request triggers do run. Why the schedule has not fired is NOT established (GitHub may delay or drop scheduled runs under load; runner queues ran 30-90 min overnight). The manual runs on PR (models, db snapshot, verified) are proven; the SCHEDULED path is not. Stays landed_unproven. Closes when a schedule-event run stamps comms/backups/kaggle_latest.json on main (models daily 04:23Z; db Sunday 2026-11-08 09:41Z); the cadence guard scripts/ci/check_cadence_liveness.py watches the receipt. If still none by 2026-11-07 06:00Z: tell the manager and propose a one-off labelled run (label kaggle-backup-request, mode models) to produce the first real stamp.

observation.what: the first SCHEDULED run of kaggle-backups.yml (models cron 23 4 * * *, due 2026-11-06 04:23Z, did not fire by 08:33Z; db cron Sunday 2026-11-08 09:41Z) completes and stamps comms/backups/kaggle_latest.json on main

If no schedule run by 2026-11-07 06:00Z: dispatch one labelled run (issue label kaggle-backup-request, mode models) for the first real stamp and file why schedules do not fire
